verification.notes: Nick Moody phone self-test, 2026-10-04. Epic copy (GameHub id 156707), not Steam. Verified with issues. physx 1.0.1 is required (the component list also showed PhysX-9.14.0702; that build was not the installed fix). Without PhysX, ShippingPC-BmGame.exe reported General protection fault! in kernelbase.dll. The game ships PhysXCore/Extensions DLLs but not PhysXLoader.dll. Launch via bm_run.bat / 0run.bat from (D:) in the virtual desktop. The library tile still launches Binaries/Batman.exe (106 KB starter) and returns after about 4 s: ExitCallback#1 returnCode=0, reason=RuntimeExited, lastFps=null, about 3915 ms. Menu/intro 55–60 FPS after PhysX and the direct exe. After Vector TSO, Memcpy TSO, and Half Barrier: menu 60 FPS, CPU 43%, about 51°C. Proton 11 was not tried. ProtonDB leads (Proton 8, -nolauncher, in-game PhysX off) were not tried. Airplane mode was not tested.

FEX preset Compatible: 14 FPS, CPU 100%, about 76°C, stuttering audio. Too slow. Not the applied preset
